goal: Enable every staff member to securely access only the functions their role permits, with zero unauthorized data exposure across store boundaries.
goal_metric: 0 unauthorized endpoint hits in production logs after auth module goes live; all 5 role types can log in and are denied correctly on out-of-scope endpoints.

actors.name: System Admin (Quản trị hệ thống)
actors.role_description: Manages the system at the highest level. Creates stores and user accounts. Has access to all data.
actors.impact: Can bootstrap the system from zero — creates the first store and first users. Can revoke access instantly by deactivating a user.

actors.name: Store Manager (Quản lý cửa hàng)
actors.role_description: Manages day-to-day store operations. Runs reports. Approves refunds.
actors.impact: Can log in and access management endpoints. Cannot access other stores' data.

actors.name: Cashier (Thu ngân)
actors.role_description: Processes sales transactions at the POS.
actors.impact: Can log in and access POS endpoints only. Cannot view financial reports or create users.

actors.name: Accountant (Kế toán)
actors.role_description: Reconciles tax invoices. Exports reports for tax authority.
actors.impact: Can log in and access accounting/invoice endpoints. Cannot process sales or manage users.

actors.name: Viewer (Người xem)
actors.role_description: Read-only access for audit or oversight purposes.
actors.impact: Can log in and view data. Cannot create, update, or delete anything.

out_of_scope: Password reset via email (future sprint — email service not yet set up)
Audit log of login events (future sprint)
